summary: Round 3 asset-wiring verification: hero-train.mp4, course-video.mp4, ai-train-stations.jpg, founder-card.jpg. Backend 8/8 pytest passing on public URL (health, enrollments, orders, tryouts, badges). Frontend @ 390x844 loads cleanly with zero console errors and zero page errors. Hero VideoBox mounts a <video> element with the correct hero-train.mp4 src, muted=true, loop=true (autoplay attribute honored — readyState=0 at capture is normal web autoplay-buffering behavior, no crash, no red screen). AI Train Stations banner renders below CTA with the ai-train-stations.jpg backdrop, 'ONE TRAIN · MANY DESTINATIONS' kicker, and campus list (Lycée Paris 8 · New York · Algiers · Kuala Lumpur · Santa Monica-Malibu · Palo Alto-Redwood City) visible. Store event cards (Halloween, Thanksgiving, etc.) render the same ai-train-stations.jpg as photographic backdrop via IMAGES.gold. Sign In screen shows founder-card.jpg as the top hero image AND at the founder card block at the bottom (Brahim BB — Founder & CEO card visible with full campaign poster). Regression: Home → track-aiml → continue-enroll → program-prof → generate-ticket produced Passenger Ticket DU-AIT-CD0J2A successfully. Course-video (VIDEOS.course) wiring is present in CourseView but the 'course' view is not reachable via a nav button in the current index.tsx (no onCourse handler wired to any Pressable in Home/AILab flows) — the URL and component are correct, only the entry point is missing.

integration_issues.issue: CourseView contains the course-video VideoBox and is fully implemented, but no Pressable in the current UI sets view='course', so users cannot reach the sample course preview screen to see course-video.mp4. Consider wiring a 'Preview Sample Course' CTA from HomeView, AILabView, or TakeActionView.

action_items: Optional: add a 'Preview Sample Course' entry point (e.g., in AILabView, HomeView, or TakeActionView) so the course-video.mp4 wiring in CourseView is actually reachable from the UI. All plumbing (VideoBox, VIDEOS.course URL, view='course' route) is already correct — just missing a Pressable trigger.
critical_code_review_comments: expo-video plugin correctly registered in app.json plugins array (appears twice at lines 28 and 43 — duplicate is harmless but should be de-duplicated for cleanliness).
VideoBox.tsx uses expo-video's useVideoPlayer + VideoView correctly (nativeControls=false, allowsFullscreen=false, loop/muted/autoplay all wired). Web autoplay is muted so browser policies allow it.
IMAGES.gold now correctly points to ai-train-stations.jpg (line 280 of appData.ts) — event backdrops verified visually.

index.tsx SignInView renders founder image twice (signInHero at line 1089 and founderPoster inside card at line 1119) — this matches the requested 'top hero image AND founder card block at the bottom' spec.
index.tsx is now 1400+ lines — split recommendation from prior iterations still stands but not blocking.
